headline: Iran Claims Three Tankers Hit Mines in Hormuz
deck: Iranian naval forces say fires followed mine strikes; vessel identities, damage and casualty details were not provided.
body: Iran’s navy and Revolutionary Guards said Saturday that fires had broken out on three oil tankers that struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz, where Tehran has restricted navigation. [E1]
The statements did not provide the vessels’ names or origins. The Guards said one of the tankers hit in southern Hormuz was a supertanker. [E2]
The Guards did not identify the vessels or provide details about casualties or damage. Reuters could not independently verify the reports. [E3] [E4]
This is a later Iranian claim than the paper’s 7 November report, which described the Guards’ account of fires involving two oil tankers and a tugboat in the strait. [E5]
The U.S. military says it has cleared the main routes through the waterway of mines. [E6]
